workPackageTitle: Pure pursuer enemy store/update/contact and fixed profiles
notes: Entries are added before implementation and are never renumbered (docs/technical/91-verification-strategy.md § Verification registry). Every entry below was authored before the production code it names.

'status' takes exactly one of 'registered', 'implemented', 'retired' (doc 91 § Entry status). 'evidenceKinds' is read against 'status' (doc 91 § What evidenceKinds means): for a 'registered' entry the list is evidence the verification will produce once built, and nothing may treat it as produced.
The structural validator for this file is owned by TASK-FND-009-002. Until it lands, the shape here matches tests/verification/PLY-001.json exactly.

This file is deliberately NOT named SIM-0*.json. tests/MechaMiner.Simulation.Tests/Support/NegativeControlCoverageTests.cs globs 'SIM-0*.json' and asserts a totals line accounting for every entry across those seven files, so adding an entry to one of them from another work package would break an unrelated package's gate.

Negative controls for these entries are recorded in tests/verification/M3-negative-controls.md. No automated gate asserts that document's coverage: the existing coverage gate (NegativeControlCoverageTests) is scoped to the seven SIM registries and its partition arithmetic is over those files only. That is stated here so a reader does not assume an enforcement that does not exist.

This slice implements the EN-01 Skitterling row of docs/31 § Ordinary roster overview and none of the other nine. docs/32:56 composes minute 0 from 'Skitterling 100%', and minute 1 is the first row needing a second identity, so authoring the other nine here would author content for a schedule row this package does not execute. Entries for the remaining identities, the shared elite treatment, and Needler's projectile are ENC-004's and ENC-005's and have no entry here yet.

TR-GEO-006 ('Valid spawns are offscreen, navigable, safe, and nonoverlapping with prohibited envelopes') is deliberately NOT cited by VER-ENC-001-004 as satisfied. Measured: the graybox arena's half extent is 20 m and the gameplay camera is about 42.7 m wide at 16:9, so no ring inside the arena is offscreen for every bearing. src/MechaMiner.Simulation/Encounters/GrayboxSpawnRing.cs records the arithmetic. The requirement is MAP-007's and GEO-005's to satisfy and is named here only so the gap is recorded rather than implied.

entries.summary: The EN-01 Skitterling profile equals the authored roster row: 20 maximum Hull, 5 contact damage, a 42% movement share that derives to 1.26 m/s against the shared 3.0 m/s baseline, and a 0.55x body scale that derives to a 0.44 m contact diameter against the Ripper's 0.80M reference.

A pursuer advances toward the mech's authoritative centre every tick at exactly its own world speed, on the direction phase 4 resolved before phase 5 integrated, and neither collides with nor is slowed by the mech or another pursuer.

Contact damage follows both documented intervals: an overlapping pursuer damages the mech immediately when eligible and then no sooner than 0.75 s later, and a resolved contact opens a 0.20 s grace during which no other pursuer may land an instance, so a crowd of any size cannot exceed one instance per 0.20 s.

Baseline replenishment executes the authored minute-0 row: a pulse of 2 every 1.50 s while the live population is below the desired minimum of 8, trimmed to the shortfall, and nothing at all once the minimum is met.

Spawn positions are deterministic and seeded: entrance bearings are drawn from the registered baseline-encounter stream family, two runs of the same seed produce byte-identical transcripts of every position, Hull, kill and ore figure over a thousand ticks, and two runs of different seeds do not.

A pursuer whose Hull reaches zero is removed through phase 12's deferred removal and never mid-iteration: the record is present for the whole of the phase that killed it, absent from the next tick's population, its identity is freed for reuse, and a reference to the dead identity resolves to nothing.
